content.value_statement: Medical device teams need consistent QMS audits for ISO 13485 readiness. This skill guides planning, execution, findings, and CAPA follow-up.
actual_capabilities: Plan risk-based ISO 13485 internal audit programs and audit schedules.
Prepare audit scopes, criteria, and evidence collection plans for QMS processes.
Structure process-based audits across management, core, support, and monitoring processes.
Classify audit findings as major nonconformities, minor nonconformities, observations, or best practices.
Connect audit findings to CAPA initiation, verification, and follow-up audit planning.
Review audit program metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
limitations: It does not replace a qualified auditor or regulatory affairs professional.
It does not certify ISO 13485 compliance or provide legal advice.
It does not access live regulatory databases or current inspection records.
Several referenced resources are placeholders unless the author adds real materials.

use_cases.title: Build an Annual Audit Program
use_cases.description: Create a risk-based schedule, define process scope, and assign auditors by competency and independence.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Audit Checklist
use_cases.description: Turn ISO 13485 clauses and internal procedures into focused questions, evidence targets, and interview topics.

use_cases.title: Verify Corrective Actions
use_cases.description: Plan follow-up evidence collection to confirm that audit findings were corrected and recurrence risk was reduced.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Audit Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ISO 13485 internal audit plan for these processes: [list processes]. Include scope, criteria, timing, and expected evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Clause Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare audit questions for ISO 13485 clause [clause]. Include objective evidence, interview prompts, and common nonconformity examples.

prompt_templates.title: Classify Audit Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Classify these audit observations as major, minor, observation, or best practice: [paste observations]. Explain the requirement and evidence for each.

prompt_templates.title: Design CAPA Follow-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a follow-up audit for this CAPA: [describe CAPA]. Include sampling, records to review, interviews, and effectiveness criteria.

output_examples.input: Create a risk-based audit plan for design controls, purchasing, production, and CAPA.
output: High priority: design controls and CAPA, with deeper sampling and senior auditor assignment.
Medium priority: purchasing and production, with supplier controls and process validation evidence.
Follow-up: review prior findings, open CAPAs, complaint trends, and management review inputs.

output_examples.input: Help document a nonconformity for incomplete design verification records.
output: Requirement: link the finding to the applicable ISO 13485 design control clause and procedure.
Evidence: identify affected records, product scope, missing verification, and sampled files.
Classification: assess whether the gap is systemic before assigning major or minor severity.

output_examples.input: Plan a follow-up audit for a training CAPA.
output: Review revised training procedures, training records, role assignments, and completion evidence.
Interview personnel to confirm understanding of the changed process.
Check recurrence indicators through recent deviations, complaints, or process monitoring results.

best_practices: Define audit criteria and evidence targets before interviews begin.
Use risk, prior findings, complaints, and process performance to set audit frequency.
Tie every finding to a requirement, objective evidence, and a clear CAPA decision.
anti_patterns: Do not audit only documents when process observation is needed.
Do not classify findings before reviewing requirement impact and recurrence risk.
Do not let auditors assess work where independence is not established.

faq.question: What standards does this skill focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on ISO 13485 quality management system audits for medical device organizations.

faq.question: Can it create an audit schedule?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help build a risk-based schedule using process criticality, prior findings, and QMS performance.

faq.question: Can it write audit questions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert clauses, procedures, and process risks into audit questions and evidence targets.

faq.question: Does it replace an auditor?
faq.answer: No. A qualified auditor must apply judgment, verify evidence, and approve final findings.

faq.question: Can it support external audit preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide readiness checks, mock audit planning, documentation review, and personnel preparation.

faq.question: Does it provide legal or certification advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides audit support content, not legal advice, regulatory certification, or official compliance approval.
